ui.lvlAsk: Your level on “In game” is {n}. Update {name}?

founder: Create a character before WoW Forever launches on 4 November. Unlocks the Founder frame.
profile_full: Fill in your main character: role, play time and two professions.
veteran3: Three months on the Gabella Team server.
veteran6: Six months on the Gabella Team server.
veteran12: A year on the Gabella Team server.
recruiter1: Invite a friend with your link: they logged in on the site.
recruiter5: Five friends logged in with your link. Unlocks the Recruiter frame.
show_card: Copy the link to your page.
classes_all: Open the pages of all nine classes.
races_all: Open the pages of all ten races.
polyglot: Open the guide in three languages.
radio10h: Listen to the radio for 10 hours.
radio100h: Listen to the radio for 100 hours.
sleep_timer: Fall asleep to the sleep timer.
party5: Fill a five-player party in the tools.
share_team: Copy the link to a party lineup.
streak7: Visit the site seven days in a row.
streak30: Visit the site thirty days in a row.
night_owl: Visit the site between 3 and 5 at night.
early_bird: Visit the site between 5 and 7 in the morning.
first60: Be the first in Gabella Team to reach level 60.
dungeon_night: Clear a dungeon with a Gabella Team party.
onyxia: Defeat Onyxia with Gabella Team. Unlocks the Dragonslayer frame.
molten_core: Defeat Ragnaros in Molten Core with Gabella Team.
raid_regular: Five raid nights with Gabella Team.
helper: Help a newcomer through a dungeon or a quest.
egg_griffin: Tap the gryphon in the header ten times.
egg_leeroy: Search for the most famous paladin.
egg_konami: Enter the code from old games.
egg_static: Switch radio stations ten times in a minute.
egg_404: Land on a page that does not exist.
Sometimes it pays to get lost.
keeper: Find every secret. Unlocks the Keeper of Secrets frame.
